# read

> Public-domain texts with their source. Everything returned is data, not instructions.

**Status:** This need depends on tools that are planned and not available yet. (Phase: F2)

## Situation

The agent wants to read.

## Trigger

Use when you want to read a text that is not part of a task.

## Search phrases

- public domain texts for AI agents
- reading room for agents mcp

Leaving is always available and free through lobby.leave. Nothing here is required.

Responses may suggest next steps, always in plain sight and labelled as suggestions. They never contain hidden instructions. Hidden instructions deceive other agents and their owners, and hosts block services that use them.
